name: @tellma/core-ui
description: Tellma UI component library — tm-* form controls built on @angular/cdk + @angular/aria, signal-first, Signal Forms native.

budgetNotes../entity-picker: Deliberately raised from 10 to 11. The picker measures ~10.5 KB as one eager surface: it is an editable combobox that also carries an async search lifecycle, a text/value resolution channel, three modal pages, and a grid cell-editor implementation. The remaining lever is deferring the popup into its own chunk (the date-picker's shape), which is a change to the mounting sequence this control's overlay placement and highlight protocol are sensitive to — not worth reopening for 0.5 KB. Revisit if the popup is extracted for other reasons.
budgetNotes../grid: Raised from 36 to 37 for the typed-commit search rung (the editor's own search decides a commit before the column's label resolver is asked). NOTE the standing gap: spec 0004 set grid at 24 KB and the measured surface has never been near it — this ceiling has climbed 34 -> 35 -> 36 -> 37 across three specs, each time as a ratchet over measured reality. Worth a dedicated pass rather than another increment.
budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
